target_customer: Young women shoppers who find fashion items on social media
problem: People see products in social posts and screenshots but cannot easily find where to buy them.
business_model: Consumer app earning affiliate or shopping referral revenue (not stated by the company)

founders.name: Michele Van Ruiten
founders.background_notes: Named CEO in Business Insider (Aug 2024) coverage; YC page lists no bio.

founders.name: Kelsey Pedersen
founders.background_notes: Listed as a founder on the YC page; no bio given.

competitors.name: ScreenShop
competitors.what: Mobile app that finds shoppable items from a screenshot, launched on iOS in 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: Visual product matching on top of existing computer vision and search APIs is feasible for a small team, with match quality across fashion items the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Reverse image shopping had many predecessors (ScreenShop, Snap Fashion, Style-Eyes, Google Lens) and no exclusive data or network effect is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search platforms offered visual search features; no source shows an incumbent copying or buying Capsule specifically.

market_need_then: TechCrunch's S22 Demo Day coverage reported that users uploaded over 1,500 images in the first week and the app matched 99 percent with shoppable links, which suggests early curiosity.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pitched as a Shazam for fashion in 2024 press

branding.brand_signature: Shazam for fashion framing in press
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Business Insider, Yahoo Tech, AOL and TechCrunch's S22 Demo Day list; no evidence of merch or fan communities.

brand_strength.rationale: Got national press coverage, but the name collides with many other Capsule companies (video editing, CRM, health) in search.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Capsule's inactive status is not public. The company got press in 2024 and a reported $1M pre-seed, but no shutdown announcement or pivot was found, and a listed generative AI shopping story in trade press could not be tied to a closure. No failure factor is assigned without a stated cause.
notes: The company website returned HTTP 503 (site status unknown). The $1.0M pre-seed dated June 2024 rests on VCBacked, with Goodwater's portfolio page also listing $1.0M pre-seed, so it is a database figure, not a press-confirmed round; a 2022 round around the batch was not found. The ScreenShop article is dated 2017 per the search summary (trade article), before the batch, and it could not be confirmed that it is the same ScreenShop later covered. Other similar apps (Snap Fashion, Style-Eyes) appeared in search with undated or older sources and are not listed. Founding year not found. Other companies named Capsule (video editing, CRM, health) are unrelated.
